patents.title: System and Method for Deep Learning Feature Classification in Multi-Modal Sensor Networks
patents.abstract: Methods and systems for training multi-layer neural network classifiers using dynamic feature extraction from multi-modal sensor arrays.
patents.claims: 1. A computer-implemented method comprising receiving sensor data streams, generating feature vectors using a convolutional neural network layer, and computing loss functions.
patents.cpc_title: Pattern recognition, machine learning classifiers, statistical feature extraction

patents.title: Decentralized Blockchain Verification Protocol with Zero-Knowledge Proof Signatures
patents.abstract: A cryptographic security framework utilizing zero-knowledge proof primitives and elliptic curve digital signatures for decentralized token verification.
patents.claims: 1. A computer-implemented method comprising generating zero-knowledge proof tokens, verifying public key hashes, and validating transaction blocks.
patents.cpc_title: Digital signatures, message authentication, cryptographic security protocols

patents.title: Recombinant Plasmid Vector for Targeted CRISPR-Cas9 Gene Editing Assays
patents.abstract: Genetic engineering constructs and recombinant DNA vectors optimized for targeted nucleotide cleavage and gene expression modulation.
patents.claims: 1. A recombinant nucleic acid molecule comprising a promoter sequence, a guide RNA targeting domain, and a Cas9 endonuclease coding sequence.
patents.cpc_title: Recombinant DNA technology, genetic engineering vectors, nucleic acid mutation

patents.title: Autonomous Flight Trajectory Control System for Multi-Rotor Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
patents.abstract: Avionics control architectures for autonomous quadcopter UAV drones featuring real-time altitude telemetry sensor fusion and trajectory optimization.
patents.claims: 1. An autonomous unmanned aerial vehicle comprising a flight control processor, rotor actuators, and sensors configured to compute dynamic aerodynamic trajectories.
patents.cpc_title: Unmanned aerial vehicles, quadcopter drone flight control, rotor craft

patents.title: Controlled Release Pharmaceutical Oral Dosage Form Comprising Solid Lipid Nanoparticles
patents.abstract: Therapeutic pharmaceutical formulations comprising lipid nanoparticle carriers for enhanced bioavailability and targeted active ingredient release.
patents.claims: 1. A pharmaceutical composition comprising a therapeutic active ingredient encapsulated within solid lipid nanoparticles and a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier.
patents.cpc_title: Pharmaceutical preparations, medicinal compounds, controlled release formulations

patents.title: Convolutional Neural Network Hardware Accelerator for Real-Time Edge Image Processing
patents.abstract: Integrated circuit architectures featuring systolic array multiplier units optimized for low-latency deep learning inference on edge computer vision devices.
patents.claims: 1. A hardware accelerator chip comprising a matrix multiplication unit, activation function logic, and high-bandwidth memory interfaces.
patents.cpc_title: Neural network hardware architectures, artificial neural networks, computing chips
